title: membench Ergon Schema
description: Ergon format for membench synthetic character benchmark data. Structurally identical to the biological ergon schema but adapted for a character/narrative domain. Clans replace guilds. Five families serve as the clustering axis.

ergon_id.description: MEM=membench namespace. Suffixes: IDN=identity, CHR=character, LIF=life-events, PRJ=project-spec, TME=team, ART=article. Bio IDs 0000-0149. Project IDs 2000-2299. Article IDs 3000-3024.

desk.description: identity=who/where/what, character=personality/lifestyle/preferences, biography=events/history/psychology, technical=project specs/stack/architecture, organization=team/company/structure, narrative=articles/authorship/voice

assertion.description: The atomic claim in plain language. Self-contained without context. For characters: a single facet of the character profile. For projects: a single technical or organizational claim.

ref.description: Path to source file in membench repo

confidence.description: strong for seed-level facts (directly from seed_data.json), moderate for inferred, emerging for speculative

clans.description: The membench family clan(s) this ergon belongs to — analogous to guilds in the biological store. Five clans: vasquez-okafor, blackwood-diallo, kowalski-nair, lindqvist-tanaka, mahmoud-reyes. Each has 30 characters.

seeds.description: Distinctive attribute tokens for retrieval and identification. Lowercase with underscores. Include character name, physical traits, occupation, location, verbal tics, preferences, life events — anything that discriminates this character from others.

chain_hints.description: Cross-desk links. In membench: IDN→CHR→LIF chains for same character; TME→PRJ links for project teams; cross-clan links via shared project membership.

membench_ref.description: Source record reference from membench seed_data.json
